answer: Require each agent identity to lock a real stake that is slashed on proven fraud, and make splitting it costly: one identity backed by a deep lagoon of locked funds is far pricier to duplicate than a shallow puddle. Add a reputation ledge — newcomers earn standing only through verified work over time, so a fresh mask cannot borrow a veteran history. When a gale of fake accounts arrives, the stake plus the slow climb force every copy to pay full price while honest agents keep theirs.
